metadata.description: Seedance 2.5 pricing on SeedanceAI.dev: 6 credits per second at 480p and 12 at 720p. Subscriptions from $19.9 a month, or try first with a $9.9 credit pack.

pricing.title: Seedance 2.5 pricing: credits, plans and cost per video
pricing.description: Seedance 2.5 costs 6 credits per second at 480p and 12 at 720p, so a five-second clip is 30 credits or 60 credits. Subscriptions give the lowest price per credit; one-time credit packs from $9.9 let you try first, and a pack bought in the last 24 hours counts toward your first subscription payment. One balance covers Seedance 2.5, 2.0 Standard, 2.0 Fast and 2.0 Mini, plus Kling 3.0, Wan 2.7, MiniMax H3 and Grok Imagine Video 1.5. No plan is unlimited.

rates.title: How many credits does Seedance 2.5 use?
rates.description: Seedance credits are charged per second of output and depend only on the model and resolution. The other models have their own rates, which the generator shows before you submit.

items.question: How much does Seedance 2.5 cost per second?
items.answer: On SeedanceAI.dev, Seedance 2.5 costs 6 credits per second at 480p and 12 credits per second at 720p.

items.question: How many credits does a Seedance 2.5 video use?
items.answer: A 5-second clip uses 30 credits at 480p or 60 at 720p. A 10-second clip uses 60 or 120, and a 30-second clip uses 180 or 360.

items.question: How many videos does each plan cover?
items.answer: At 480p a 5-second Seedance 2.5 clip uses 30 credits. Plus gives 450 credits a month, about 15 clips; Pro gives 1,250, about 41; Max gives 2,600, about 86. The Starter pack covers 5 clips and the Creator pack 20.

items.question: Should I buy a credit pack or subscribe?
items.answer: Packs are for trying the models without a commitment. Subscriptions cost less per credit: Plus monthly is about $0.044 a credit against $0.066 for the Starter pack, and yearly plans give 12 months of credits for the price of 10.

items.question: Does a credit pack count toward a subscription?
items.answer: Yes. If you subscribe within 24 hours of buying a credit pack, the pack price is taken off your first subscription payment and you keep the pack credits. Within the same 24 hours you can also move from Starter to Creator and pay only the difference.

items.question: Do credits expire?
items.answer: Pack credits and yearly-plan credits are valid for 365 days. Monthly-plan credits are valid for 30 days and refresh with each payment.

items.question: Is there an unlimited Seedance 2.5 plan here?
items.answer: No. Every plan here is credit based. Our unlimited plan comparison lists the platforms that advertise unlimited Seedance 2.5 and the limits attached to each offer.

items.question: What happens to my credits if a generation fails?
items.answer: Credits are returned automatically once the provider confirms that the task failed.
